title: army-pool-edge config
description: One config file drives the whole edge. scripts/lib/config.mjs is the fail-closed enforcement; this schema documents the same contract for editors. Secrets (the upstream pool key) are NEVER config: they are wrangler secrets. Security behavior (sealed prefixes, header hygiene, token weights, probe policy) is NOT configurable.

edgeName.description: Worker name and the `service` value reported by /health. Monitors key on it; pick it once.

publicOrigin.description: The https origin this edge serves (bare origin, no path). Becomes the custom-domain route and PUBLIC_BASE_URL.

baseUrl.description: The upstream pool-meter origin (bare https origin). Rendered into wrangler.toml as UPSTREAM_BASE_URL. Must differ from publicOrigin.

allowedOrigins.description: Browser origins allowed to call the edge (e.g. your army instance site). publicOrigin is always included automatically.

prefix.description: Prefix for contributor edge tokens. Default army_.

tiers.description: Grant tiers. MUST include `contributor` (the fallback for unknown tier names). `models: null` means unrestricted; a list restricts by model-name prefix.

grantIncreaseNote.description: Appended to the 429 grant-exhausted error. Operator-supplied copy.

passthroughAssets.description: Extra GET-exact upstream asset paths served anonymously through the edge (e.g. a brand mark the upstream pages reference). Each entry is one exact path, never a prefix.

namespaceId.description: Cloudflare KV namespace id (create with `wrangler kv namespace create POOL_EDGE`). Empty until you create it; the render step warns while it is empty.
